verdict.rationale: Sentry documents OTLP ingestion so teams can instrument with an OTel SDK or Collector and send data to Sentry, which supports the 'open standards' half of the story, but Sentry's primary recommended integration path is its own proprietary SDKs ('Drop in the SDK'), and there is no documentation showing a workflow for switching backends without re-instrumentation once OTel data is being sent. Missing for 10: explicit guidance/tooling for backend portability, OTel semantic-convention compliance details, and independent evidence of teams switching backends with unchanged instrumentation.
